spans.text: Ajay Bandagi
Senior Accounts Executive with 3.5 years of experience in India Finance Operations, Accounts Payable, statutory
compliances, and payroll management. Proven ability to independently manage month-end close, high-volume
transactions of ₹1–2 Cr per month, and compliance-driven finance operations. Strong hands-on experience in
GST, TDS, PF/PT/ESIC, payroll processing, MIS reporting, and audit coordination. Known for ownership, accuracy,
statutory discipline, and timely closures in fast-paced environments.
ajaybandagi1998@gmail.com
Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
